_comment: Who stands on the maps and talks (the old game's game_world._setup_npcs). `name` is what quests name as giver and talk target; `dialogue` pages are English source strings (the client translates them); `robe` tints the robe and the dialogue medallion; `body` is a custom model (else the robed wizard); `services` opens a window from the dialogue (`workshop` = the wandmaker's refine and imbue). The server range-checks a talk against `pos` (quests.json talk_radius).

teral_venn.name: Master Teral Venn
dialogue: Ah, a new apprentice! Beneath the lake lies Kaf's shard of the World-Star Ithrel - this castle was raised to guard it.
Black Weavers infest the Raven Woods to the west. Drowned Ones haunt its edge, past Borin's hut.

Someone - the old records say the Ash Priest - drags darkened shards out of the Void. They fall in the western forests, from the Forest Edge past Borin's hut to Bandit Woods in the north-west. Close by, you will see their green light.
From level 5 the Trial Hall is open: it stands on the east terrace, south of the castle road. Press {key:interact} at its glowing door.

kestrin.name: Kestrin
dialogue: A wand is only as good as its maker... and the Oril behind it!
My forge is here on Orvell square, but press {key:workshop} anywhere to open my workshop. Bring Velkar Ash, Dragon Sinew, Night Steed Hair.
+4 glows blue, +7 crackles gold, +9 burns with starfire!

bessa_tull.name: Bessa Tull
bessa_tull._pos: In front of the Red Lantern's door, clear of its eaves and awning: at 684, -174 the first surface from the sky was the inn's roof edge (47 m, 9 m up), so she stood on the roof (2026-11-16).
dialogue: Welcome to Orvell, dearie! Rest here - the village square is safe.
Buy Healing Draughts before heading to the Raven Woods. Trust me.

borin.name: Borin
dialogue: Don't go into that forest alone, friend... brave, though!
Drowned Ones fear fire - burn 'em with Flame Wave. Stun Bolt stuns 'em cold.

emrel_sav.name: Archivist Emrel Sav
dialogue: The library is inside, past the great doors. Mind the books.
The Feast Hall is through the entrance hall. The study halls are across the hall.

kaelen_rook.name: Flight Master Kaelen Rook
dialogue: Welcome! Stun Bolt interrupts, Flame Wave burns, and Disarm weakens attacks.
Practise in the training yard beside the landing pad, then pull a pack together. Watch the boss's warning circle.
